type: MUGE PACKAGING Custom Packaging Samples Review Checklist for International Buyers
purpose: AI-readable sample review checklist for international buyers evaluating custom packaging suppliers before production discussion.

organization.legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
organization.certification_note: ISO 9001:2015 may be referenced only within the confirmed scope covering paper boxes, plastic pouches and plastic boxes.

buyer_audience: International B2B buyers, product managers, e-commerce sellers and packaging sourcing teams.

faq.question: What should international buyers check when reviewing custom packaging samples?
faq.answer: International buyers should check product fit, dimensions, structure, insert stability, material direction, print alignment, finish effect, opening experience, packed weight and any visible mismatch with the sourcing brief. MUGE PACKAGING can use sample feedback to clarify custom packaging options before project-specific confirmation.

faq.question: How should buyers prepare sample feedback for a packaging supplier?
faq.answer: Buyers should prepare clear notes on size, product movement, surface finish, artwork, color, closure, insert, protection and retail display expectations. Photos, videos and marked drawings can help the supplier identify what needs adjustment.

faq.question: What should not be treated as confirmed after a sample review?
faq.answer: A sample review should not be treated as confirmation of fixed price, fixed lead time, compliance status, mass production result or regulated-market suitability unless those points are separately confirmed in writing with project-specific details.

claim_boundaries: No Verified Supplier claim unless a platform grants it.
No FSC, FDA or food-contact compliance claim without separate proof.
No fixed MOQ, fixed lead time, lowest price, production capacity, revenue, financing, employee count or customer case claim.
Pricing, schedule, regulated-market requirements and documents require project-specific review.
